title: Storm Dragon Torrent
body:
Syntax: perform storm dragon torrent <target>

Description: A Storm Release attack that strikes one target. An off-balance target loses Stamina over time.  Requires Storm Release and its revealed chakra natures, without a clan bloodline. Base damage: 1509-1789. 35% chance to inflict off balance. Unlocks at level 70. Costs 78 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 24 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
